messages:
sara-cs: Hey team — DeltaHealth's security guy just sent over a vendor risk pack. They want a data flow diagram, SOC2 report, and confirmation on encryption/backup policies. Can we assemble quick answers?

mike-legal: I can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II. Need to confirm the audit period (last one was Feb 2025). Ok to share redacted PDF? :eyes:

anika-pd: For data flow, they specifically asked whether PHI elements are ever stored. Short answer: no PHI is persisted by default; customers can store embeddings/records if they opt in. We should spell that out.

oliver-ops: Quick facts:
- Hosted: request logs retained 30d, encrypted at rest (AES-256 on S3).
- Dedicated: customer can enable KMS CMKs.
- Private/on-prem: depends on customer-managed infra.

oliver-ops: KMS aliases below for reference:
```
alias/redwood-hosted -> aws-managed
alias/redwood-customer-<acct> -> customer-kms
```

sara-cs: Delta also asked about backups and disaster recovery RTO/RPO. What numbers are safe to give?

oliver-ops: For Hosted: RTO ~4 hours for regional incidents, RPO ~1 hour for critical state (KV cache). Snapshots retained 365d. Add that we have automated cross-region fallbacks.

mike-legal: Also need to provide subprocessors list and our DPA link. Point them to https://redwood.com/legal/subprocessors and https://redwood.com/legal/dpa

dev-bot: Uploaded redacted SOC2: https://internal.redwood.com/files/soc2-2025-redacted.pdf (access: deltahealth@external)

sara-cs: Thanks — I'll draft a short reply compiling the above. Request: can ops confirm the exact backup retention names so I don't mix 90/365? Also if anyone objects to sharing redacted SOC2.

oliver-ops: Confirmed: logs=30d, snapshots=365d, backups for DB replicas=90d. :thumbsup:

mike-legal: No objections to sending redacted SOC2. Recommend adding watermark "redacted for vendor review".

sara-cs: Perfect. I'll send the response and attach the SOC2 PDF + data flow diagram (I'll export the Visio as PNG). Will loop in Delta's security lead. Thanks all :pray:

mike-legal: FYI mark this thread as 'confidential' in the portal and record that access granted to deltahealth@external.

sara-cs: noted — updating case #DH-489 and adding links.
